content.short: Growi Finance is a quantitative digital-asset manager building institutional onchain products.
content.description: Growi Finance is a quantitative manager building on-chain yield products for institutions and private clients. Its conservative lending strategy is built on Morpho and live on HyperEVM, with the firm reporting more than 1,500 clients and over 15 million dollars in TVL since launching in July 2024. Performance figures are drawn directly from its Hyperliquid vault. Products are also available on Pacifica and Hibachi alongside Hyperliquid.
content.meta: Systematic quant strategies packaged as institutional onchain products on Hyperliquid.
